title: Playboy Sharon Stone La Toya Jackson Lot of 4 1990 1992 Christmas Issue + Bonus
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1990–1992 featuring Sharon Stone, La Toya Jackson and other notable celebrities, interviews and pictorials.

Included are:

July 1990 – Sharon Stone
Features Sharon Stone on the cover with her pictorial, plus a Quincy Jones interview conducted by Alex Haley, an Aaron Neville feature, and Jacqueline Sheen as Playmate of the Month. 

November 1991 – La Toya Jackson
Features La Toya Jackson on the cover with an all-new pictorial and material from her autobiography. Also includes a Sean Penn interview and 20 Questions with Julia Roberts. 

August 1992 – All-American Housewife Issue
Features Playboy’s Salute to the All-American Housewife pictorial, along with an interview with British politician Derek Humphry and other articles and features from the issue. 

December 1992 – Sharon Stone Christmas Issue
Gala Christmas issue featuring Sharon Stone and a Playboy interview tied to the Basic Instinct era. Also includes a vintage Bettie Page feature, Jessica Hahn pictorial, 20 Questions with photographer Helmut Newton, Sex Stars of 1992, Arthur C. Clarke, Joyce Carol Oates, and Penn & Teller. 

Original vintage Playboy magazines. Pre-owned with normal signs of age, storage and handling. Covers may show light surface wear, scuffing, edge or corner wear consistent with vintage magazines. Overall, the copies pictured present nicely for their age.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents. You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.

Great lot for collectors of vintage Playboy magazines, Sharon Stone, La Toya Jackson, 1990s pop culture and celebrity memorabilia.
